policy: Content-equivalence audit under spec v1 section-3 human-registration clause. Both audits are retrieval-blind and validator-clean; select the independent review for every qid: it re-verified all 9 fixes (incl. the 0351 group replacement and material-difference exclusions) and all 17 passes against source text, and additionally found one defective legacy member on v3-offline-0170 (j01249 span ends mid-definition of a different rider and does not support the 90-day claim), correcting pass to fix by removing it.
